title: CombatScenario input (the Python scenario spec dict)
description: Shape of the Python dict STS2_RL/Combat/battle_emulator.py:build_scenario_from_spec() converts into a C# Sts2Emulator.Dto.CombatScenario for GameInstance.ResetFromScenario(). v2 (this file) adds HandCards/DrawPileCards/DiscardPileCards/ExhaustPileCards (per-card upgrade state), Potions (potion belt), PlayerHp/PlayerMaxHp independently-nullable fields, and Stars. v1 (bare Hand/DrawPile/etc. string lists, no Potions/Stars, HP always both-specified) is still accepted and still produced by callers that have no per-card upgrade/potion/HP/Stars data to offer - see 'v1_compat' notes below. Source of truth: Sts2Emulator/Dto/CombatScenario.cs, CardInstanceScenario.cs, PotionScenario.cs.

player_hp.description: Maps to CombatScenario.PlayerHp. Null (or field omitted) = 'let nature take its course' (full HP at whichever max applies, post-relics). Independently nullable from player_max_hp - see the four PlayerHp/PlayerMaxHp combinations in CombatScenario.PlayerHp's/PlayerMaxHp's doc comments (both null / max-only / hp-only / both). Applied AFTER relics are granted, so a max-HP-changing relic (e.g. a Mango-style +14) is never double-counted with an explicit value here - do not attempt to pre-subtract/adjust for such a relic's effect when setting this.

player_max_hp.description: Maps to CombatScenario.PlayerMaxHp. Same null/independent-nullability semantics as player_hp - see that field's description.

hand.description: v1 form - plain card id strings, every card created unupgraded. Ignored by the emulator if hand_cards is also non-empty (specifying both non-empty throws) - use hand_cards instead when upgrade state is known.

draw_pile.description: v1 form - see 'hand'. Index 0 is top-of-pile / next drawn.

hand_cards.description: v2 structured form of 'hand' - use when per-card upgrade state is known. Not merged with 'hand'; specifying both non-empty for the same pile throws ArgumentException at ResetFromScenario time.

slot.description: 0-based potion slot index. Duplicate or out-of-range (for the player's post-relic MaxPotionCount, 3 by default, raised by relics like Potion Belt granted in the same scenario's relics list) throws ArgumentException.

potions.description: Complete, exact potion-belt state - NOT additive to any default. Empty/omitted = no potions. Unlisted slots (up to MaxPotionCount) are empty. No AfterObtained-style pickup hook exists for potions (unlike relics), so there is nothing to auto-skip here.

orb_slots.description: Maps to CombatScenario.OrbSlots. Optional exact orb-slot count override for Orb-capable characters/states.

orbs.description: Ordered orb queue state. Index 0 is the next orb to evoke, so order is gameplay-meaningful and must be preserved.

pending_choice.description: Optional exact restore of a StartOfCombat pending choice already visible in Observation.pendingChoice. ActionContinuation choices must not be fed back into CombatScenario.PendingChoice.

relics.description: Granted via the real RelicCmd.Obtain, so AfterObtained() fires for real for every relic here. For relics whose AfterObtained() includes a genuine interactive card-choice pickup ritual (e.g. LEAD_PAPERWEIGHT, CLAWS - 24 total, see Sts2Emulator.Api.Internal.RealEngine.AutoSkipCardSelector's doc comment for the full list), that prompt is now automatically auto-declined rather than hanging (fixed in the 2026-07-20 15:49 build - see Combat/evaluation/reports/emulator_hang/ for the investigation that found this before the fix landed). Every other part of such a relic's AfterObtained() (unconditional side effects) still runs in full.

stars.description: Maps to CombatScenario.Stars. Null (or field omitted) leaves the real combat-start sequence untouched, including Regent's DIVINE_RIGHT natural grant. When supplied, it is an exact non-negative override applied after normal turn-1 setup, at the same late timing as Energy.

slot_name_manifest.description: RL-side provenance for EnemyScenario.SlotName restoration. Not passed directly to CombatScenario; written by Combat/slot_name_inference.py so teacher data can distinguish source-history slots from encounter-definition/order inference.

source.description: STS2_RL-side provenance metadata (server_id/build_id/act_number/pool_type/encounter/etc.) - not part of CombatScenario, stripped before conversion. Ascension is NOT settable via CombatScenario/ResetFromScenario at all (only the simpler Reset() takes an ascension parameter) - if present here it is documentation-only, not applied.

is_upgraded.description: Requesting true for a non-upgradable card (most Status/Curse cards, or a card already at MaxUpgradeLevel) throws ArgumentException - do not set true speculatively; only set it from a source that actually recorded upgrade state (e.g. a real run's current_upgrade_level > 0).

tinker_time_type.description: Optional MAD_SCIENCE-specific per-instance state mirrored from Observation card.tinkerTimeType.

tinker_time_rider.description: Optional MAD_SCIENCE-specific per-instance state mirrored from Observation card.tinkerTimeRider.

dynamic_vars.description: exact-match (case-sensitive) internal DynamicVar overrides; unknown keys throw.

base_passive_value.description: Optional exact base passive value for mutable orbs such as Dark/Glass.

base_evoke_value.description: Optional exact base evoke value for mutable orbs such as Dark/Glass.

max_hp.description: Null = reuse hp as max (100% health).

slot_name.description: Set for the handful of slot-dependent monsters (Exoskeleton/Myte/PhantasmalGardener/Wriggler) to avoid a silent 'UNSET_MOVE' placeholder intent.
